title: Mishy Mish Mash
style: Pop-rap with bouncy syncopated percussion, slap bass, crowd-clap accents, and playful chant hooks; verse rides quick commentator patter, pre-chorus tightens with filtered hand drums and rising whistles, chorus hits with gang vocals on the name drop. Vocal delivery is bright, punchy, and talk-sung with doubled hook lines, ad-libbed shoutbacks, and short delay throws on key phrases. Ear candy includes squeaky shoe fills, score-call stabs, and a quick riser into each chorus. Mix is crisp, wide, and arena-ready with a glossy live-broadcast sheen.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Welcome to the court side show
White lines shining, paddle glow
Michelle in the corner, calm and mean
Reads that bounce like a movie scene

Live in the booth, they call the play
“She sees it first” — that’s what they say
Mishy on deck, no wasted motion
Soft hands, sharp eyes, pure devotion

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, here it comes
That little dart
She sets the pace
Then breaks your heart

[Chorus]
Mishy mish mash, oh
Michelle got the smash
Mishy mish mash, go
She makes the whole board crash
Mishy mish mash, hey
Watch that angle flash
Mishy mish mash, now
Coach Michelle brings the clash (mishy mish mash)

[Verse 2]
Commentators leaning in close
“Look at that save” — she knows the most
Sideline grin and a clipboard twist
Every comeback lives in her wrist

Kitchen line, she owns that space
Moves one step and steals the place
Call her Michelle, call her the guide
She turns doubt into court-side pride

[Pre-Chorus]
Crowd on its feet
Phones in the air
She sees the gap
Before it’s there

[Chorus]
Mishy mish mash, oh
Michelle got the smash
Mishy mish mash, go
She makes the whole board crash
Mishy mish mash, hey
Watch that angle flash
Mishy mish mash, now
Coach Michelle brings the clash (mishy mish mash)

[Bridge]
One two, say her name
Every rally, same
Slow hands, fast mind
Best in the game

[Final Chorus]
Mishy mish mash, oh
Michelle got the smash
Mishy mish mash, go
She makes the whole board crash
Mishy mish mash, hey
Watch that angle flash
Mishy mish mash, now
Coach Michelle brings the clash (mishy mish mash)
